title: Wonderful alloy
description:
A mod that adds new alloys to Minecraft.
Steel armor and tools have more durability than iron armor and are not far behind in terms of protection, efficiency, and damage.
body:
mod that adds new alloys to minecraft
1.0 added steel ore and armor made from it!
1.1 Added more steel functionality, tools, and crafting
Steel armor and tools have more durability than iron armor and are not far behind in terms of protection, efficiency, and damage.
